senses.gloss: m. (τετράγωνος) four-cornered, in a quadrangle, in a square.
units: <cite ref="Nazir 8b:11">Naz. 8ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 164b:10">B. Bath. 164ᵇ</cite> (<he>בית</he>) <he>ט׳</he> a house of four corners.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:8">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> (expl. <he>תלפיות</he>) <he>טֶטְרָגוֹנִין</he> (τετραγώνιον) in a square.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> <cite ref="B00239"><he>בוטרגונין</he></cite> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="A02406"><he>אִסְטְרוֹנְגִּילוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 1:2">Tosef. Naz. I, 2</cite> <he>הריני נזיר ט׳ וכ׳</he> ‘I will be a Nazir tetragon’, means four times; Naz. l. c.; B. Bath. l. c.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 78:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 49</cite> <he>מט׳ היה</he> (corr. acc.) each plague was fourfold; ed. Bub. <cite ref="I00283"><he>טֶטְרָאגוֹן</he></cite>.
